# Renie Namocot

> Renie Namocot is a freelance full-stack web developer based in the Philippines, specialising in WordPress (custom themes, plugins, headless WordPress with Next.js, Elementor, Divi, ACF, WooCommerce) and Shopify (custom Online Store 2.0 themes, Shopify Admin/Storefront REST & GraphQL APIs, Hydrogen). Renie has built more than 1,000 websites (most under NDA for agencies and brands), and also builds Stripe/PayPal payment integrations, online booking systems, business automations (Zapier, Make, n8n), Figma-to-WordPress conversions and custom web apps (Laravel, React, Node.js). Renie also built and runs two SaaS products: tarsiflow (https://tarsiflow.com/, client management for freelancers and agencies) and MyTindahan (https://mytindahan.store/, a store app for sari-sari and grocery stores in the Philippines with 1,500+ sign-ups). Clients across Australia, United States, United Kingdom, Germany, New Zealand, Singapore. Contact: rnamocotdev@gmail.com

## Services
- [WordPress Development](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/wordpress-development/): Freelance WordPress developer building fast, secure, custom WordPress websites: themes, plugins, WooCommerce, headless and page builders. Remote, worldwide.
- [Custom WordPress Themes](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/custom-wordpress-theme-development/): Custom WordPress theme development: hand-coded block themes, Gutenberg blocks and ACF layouts built for speed, accessibility and easy editing.
- [WordPress Plugin Development](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/wordpress-plugin-development/): Custom WordPress plugin development: bespoke features, API integrations, WooCommerce extensions and admin tools, built to WordPress coding standards.
- [Headless WordPress](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/headless-wordpress-development/): Headless WordPress development with Next.js, React and WPGraphQL. Blazing-fast, secure front ends with WordPress as the editor-friendly CMS.
- [Elementor Development](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/elementor-development/): Elementor Pro developer building fast, pixel-perfect, editable WordPress sites with global design systems, custom widgets, dynamic content and ACF.
- [Divi Development](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/divi-development/): Divi developer for custom Divi websites, child themes, Theme Builder templates and custom Divi modules. Fast, responsive and easy for your team to update.
- [ACF Development](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/acf-development/): ACF Pro development: custom post types, flexible content, ACF Gutenberg blocks and options pages that make WordPress structured and easy to manage.
- [WooCommerce Development](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/woocommerce-development/): WooCommerce developer building custom online stores with Stripe and PayPal payments, subscriptions, product configurators and ERP/inventory integrations.
- [Shopify Development](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/shopify-development/): Shopify developer building custom Online Store 2.0 themes in Liquid, Shopify apps, Storefront and Admin API integrations, Hydrogen headless stores and migrations.
- [Stripe & PayPal Integration](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/stripe-paypal-payment-integration/): Stripe and PayPal payment integration for WordPress, WooCommerce and custom web apps: checkout, subscriptions, deposits, invoices and secure webhooks.
- [Online Booking Systems](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/online-booking-system-development/): Online booking systems for WordPress: live availability, Stripe/PayPal deposits, reminders and Google Calendar sync for clinics, studios and services.
- [Automation & Integrations](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/wordpress-automation/): Automate WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify with Zapier, Make, n8n and webhooks. Connect forms, CRM, email and orders and save hours every week.
- [Figma to WordPress](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/figma-to-wordpress/): Pixel-perfect Figma, Adobe XD, PSD and HTML to WordPress conversion: responsive, fast, accessible and easy to edit with Gutenberg, ACF, Elementor or Divi.
- [Responsive Web Design](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/web-design/): Modern, responsive web design for business websites and online stores: mobile-first UI, conversion-focused layouts, accessibility and SEO-ready structure.
- [Technical SEO & Analytics](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/technical-seo-analytics/): Technical SEO audits, Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Tag Manager setup, event and conversion tracking for WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify sites.
- [Custom Web Development](https://rnamocotdev.com/services/custom-web-development/): Full-stack custom web development: dashboards, management systems, SaaS applications and REST/GraphQL APIs using Laravel, PHP, React, Next.js and Node.js.
